title: Amazon is buying Whole Foods in a deal valued at $13.7 billion
主要内容: Amazon has agreed to acquire Whole Foods in a deal valued at $13.7 billion, with the transaction priced at $42 per share. The deal is expected to close in the second half of the year. John Mackey, Whole Foods' CEO, will remain in his position after the acquisition, and the store will continue to operate under the Whole Foods brand. The acquisition is seen as a strategic move for Amazon to expand its online grocery business, which it views as an emerging opportunity. Whole Foods shares surged by 28% following the announcement, reflecting investor optimism. The deal comes amid pressure from activist investors like Jana Partners, who have called for Whole Foods to be sold. Analysts suggest that the acquisition could help Amazon more aggressively target fresh food delivery to the at-home market. Walmart, which has been focusing on its digital business, is also seen as a potential competitor in the online grocery space. Amazon's stock rose following the news, indicating investor confidence in the strategic move.
